title: The gap searcher's candidates (fact:gapCandidates)
description: Issue 966 spec 4.4: the searcher states its own model, lists every search it ran (the audit trail), and reports each candidate with a citation, the excerpt, the query that found it, an anchor and why it matters. step.scope.gap-log pairs the candidates with the judge's rulings.

model.description: The searcher's own statement of its model; "unknown" is allowed. The record of what ran is the ledger's, not this.

id.description: The searcher's own number for the candidate: C1, C2 and so on, once each in the file.

citation.description: A node key, code:<path> or a record id.

excerpt.description: What the retrieval returned, at most 400 characters.

query.description: The search that found the candidate; it is one of the queries in searches[] (the log does not check that, the owner reads it).

anchor.description: A node key or code:<path> that regather can start from.

why.description: The searcher's argument. The judge never sees it.
